purpose: Reusable L1.5 interface between the seven L1 experts and downstream L2.

seven_king_consensus.horse_order: Top6 Borda: each expert rank r contributes 7-r points; ties use support, top1 votes, best rank, mean rank, horse_id.
seven_king_consensus.anchors: First two horses of the seven-king consensus order.

outsider_router.action: On Gate alert, choose exactly two outsiders and add only Top6 horse IDs absent from the seven-king union.

rules: candidate_horse_ids begins with seven_consensus_order and appends only novel outsider horses.
Outsider horses do not replace or re-rank seven-king anchors inside L1.5.
If gate_alert is false, selected_outsiders and novel_horse_ids are empty.
Odds, popularity and payout are forbidden inputs in L1/L1.5.

l2_walk_forward_2023_2025.note: Evidence for freezing K2 over BASE/K3; final odds are a historical execution-price proxy.

immutability.change_policy: Any Gate, consensus, outsider, ranking or output-schema change creates L15_FIXED_V2 or later.
immutability.production_note: 2026 remains sealed; this V1 is for historical replay/downstream research until the sealed-year policy changes.
